primary_case_law.case: O'Flaherty & Ors v Permanent TSB Public Ltd Company & Ors [2026] IEHC 74
primary_case_law.role: current boundary/map dispute involving folios, registry mapping and easement issues

verified_proposition: Except where the Registration of Title Act provides otherwise, the register/map description is not conclusive as to boundaries or extent; specific statutory mechanisms can make an ascertained boundary conclusive. A title plan therefore cannot automatically be represented as a universal determination of the physical boundary on the ground.
judicial_limit: O'Flaherty is a fact-specific High Court decision and is used to demonstrate the evidential complexity of map/boundary disputes, not as a universal statement replacing ss.84-86.
evidence_rule: Where folio, title plan, deeds, physical occupation and boundary evidence conflict, the platform must expose the conflict and identify the additional evidence/procedure required.
remaining: Final publication source audit and possessory-title gap.
